job.title: Education RAG Development Using Open Source Models
job.description: We’re building a lean, production-ready Education RAG system that answers student/instructor questions using curated PDFs, slides, and notes. The stack will be open-source (LLM, embeddings, vector DB, reranker), with strong emphasis on accurate answers, page-level citations, and Socratic tutoring mode.
responsibilities: Design and implement a hybrid retrieval pipeline (BM25 + dense) with cross-encoder reranking
Ingest/parse educational PDFs/slides; implement page/slide-aware chunking and metadata (course, unit, topic, difficulty)
Wire an open-source instruct LLM (e.g., Llama-3-8B/Qwen-2-7B) via Ollama or llama.cpp; add prompt templates for tutor mode
Build an API (FastAPI/Flask) with endpoints for /ingest, /query, /feedback
Implement citations (doc + page) and response guardrails (no missing-context hallucinations)
Provide Docker setup + readme; handoff with documentation
deliverables: Running service (Docker Compose) with Vector DB (Qdrant/Weaviate/FAISS)
Ingestion scripts (PyMuPDF/unstructured) with metadata + page spans
API + example client (CLI or minimal web UI)
Evaluation notebook + baseline metrics (faithfulness, context recall)
Ops: logging, config, reproducible env, brief runbook
required_skills: Proven RAG builds with open-source models (links or repos)
Python (FastAPI), embeddings, vector search, BM25, cross-encoders
PDF/slide parsing (PyMuPDF), text normalization, chunking strategies
Docker, basic CI, and pragmatic benchmarking
nice_to_have: Math-aware formatting (LaTeX handling), diagram/figure caption handling

timeline_budget.duration: 3–6 weeks for v1 (MVP), with option to extend
timeline_budget.budget: Fixed-price for MVP + hourly for follow-ups

application_requirements: 3 relevant RAG links (repos, demos) + brief note on your role
3–5 sentence approach to hybrid retrieval + reranking for edu content
Earliest start date and weekly availability in IST
Short paid screening task: ingest 2 sample PDFs, return answers with page-level citations for 10 test queries, share metrics and short readme

proposal.text:
Hi Harish,

I’m excited about your vision of building a lean, production-ready Education RAG system that not only answers student/instructor questions accurately but also provides page-level citations and a Socratic tutoring mode. I’ve been working on similar projects and even shared a demo video on Upwork to give you a sense of my hands-on experience.

Some relevant work:
📌 RAG Implementation – Built a retrieval-augmented pipeline using LangChain, Pinecone, and Hugging Face for intelligent document querying.
Repo: https://github.com/Adieltheanalyst/Rag

📌 Chatbot with PDF Support – Developed a demo that ingests PDFs and provides context-aware answers.
Live demo: https://adieltheanalyst-chatbot-creation-pdf-support-wmtxbn.streamlit.app/

📌 NLP Projects (Sentiment Analysis & Classification) – Applied ML/NLP techniques on real-world datasets like Jumia reviews to extract business insights.

For your project, here’s my high-level approach:
Hybrid Retrieval – Combine BM25 with dense embeddings (e.g., bge-m3) and apply cross-encoder reranking to ensure precise, citation-ready answers.
Educational PDF Ingestion – Implement page-aware chunking with PyMuPDF/unstructured and store metadata (course, unit, difficulty) for structured querying.
LLM Integration – Serve open-source models like Llama-3 or Qwen via Ollama/llama.cpp, fine-tuned with prompt templates for tutoring and math-friendly responses.
API + Deployment – Expose endpoints (/ingest, /query, /feedback) via FastAPI, with Docker Compose setup for reproducibility and easy handoff.
Evaluation – Use ragas/TruLens for baseline metrics (faithfulness, context recall) and telemetry for continuous monitoring.

A few clarifications to align with your needs:
- Do you already have a preferred vector DB (Qdrant, Weaviate, FAISS), or should I recommend based on scalability and resource limits?
- Should the tutoring mode focus primarily on math-heavy content (LaTeX/diagrams) or general course notes first?
- Are you looking to keep the stack entirely open-source, or would limited commercial APIs be acceptable for fallback?

I can start as early as this week and dedicate focused hours to ensure v1 is ready within your 3–6 week timeline. I’m also comfortable with your short paid screening task to demonstrate capability.

Looking forward to collaborating on a solution that transforms your educational content into a truly interactive learning assistant.

Best regards,
Adiel Ngugi
